title: Air Cooler Covers
description: Protective covers for air coolers of all types and sizes. Our air cooler covers shield your unit from dust, rain, sun, and wind damage when not in use.

seoContent.intro: Air cooler covers shield portable and fixed evaporative units from dust, sun, and rain when not operating. The term covers residential swamp coolers, commercial air coolers, and OEM cabinet styles — sizing always follows outside width, depth, and height.
highlights: Lightweight 300D–600D options for easy on/off
Universal and custom-fit patterns for non-standard cabinets
UV and waterproof upgrades for outdoor storage
Bulk pricing for property managers with multiple units

faqs.q: What sizes do air cooler covers come in?
faqs.a: Standard charts cover many residential footprints; custom sizing handles any cabinet measurement. Measure the exterior box, not the pad opening.

faqs.q: Are air cooler and evaporative cooler covers interchangeable?
faqs.a: Yes. Use the same measurement method and material choice. Browse our evaporative cooler covers category for the full material and feature range.

faqs.q: How do I secure the cover in wind?
faqs.a: Use the supplied drawcord or straps at all anchor points. Rooftop installs should use four-corner tie-down with 600D fabric or heavier.

faqs.q: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.a: Yes. We manufacture to order and ship worldwide. Request a quote with your dimensions and destination for freight options.

title: Bulk Order Cooler Covers
description: Volume pricing for large orders of evaporative cooler covers. Ideal for property management companies, HVAC contractors, and distributors. Significant discounts on orders of 50+ units.

seoContent.intro: Bulk cooler cover orders give HVAC distributors and property managers consistent fabric, color, and sizing across dozens or hundreds of units. Volume tiers reduce per-cover cost while holding one material spec for simpler inventory.

Mixed sizes on one PO with shared fabric code
Optional single-color logo on commercial runs
Dedicated account support for repeat schedules

faqs.q: What is the minimum for bulk pricing?
faqs.a: Volume discounts start at 25 units. Orders below that use standard custom per-unit pricing.

faqs.q: Can each cover in a bulk order be a different size?
faqs.a: Yes. Submit a dimension spreadsheet; we cut each cover to spec with the same material and branding.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I order for a season?
faqs.a: Place orders 4–6 weeks before peak install season. Rush production may be available for existing pattern IDs.

faqs.q: Do you store patterns for reorder?
faqs.a: Yes. Approved patterns are saved by customer ID for one-click seasonal reorders.

Optional logo printing for branded property maintenance
Volume pricing tiers starting at 25 units
Dedicated account contact for repeat purchasing

faqs.q: What is the minimum order for commercial covers?
faqs.a: There is no strict minimum, but volume pricing begins at 25 units. Below that the per-unit cost is the same as our standard custom line.

faqs.q: Can you match covers across many different unit sizes?
faqs.a: Yes. Send a spreadsheet of unit models and dimensions; we produce a mixed batch with consistent fabric, color, and branding across every size.

faqs.q: Do you offer branded or printed covers?
faqs.a: Single-color logo printing is included on orders of 50 units or more. Full-color printing and custom fabric colors are available on request.

faqs.q: What is the lead time for a commercial order?
faqs.a: Standard orders ship in 10 to 14 business days. Larger orders above 200 units typically require 3 to 4 weeks depending on fabric availability.

Logo printing and mixed-size bulk batches on one purchase order

faqs.q: Can I mix sizes in one custom order?

title: Down Draft Cooler Covers
description: Specialized covers for down-draft evaporative coolers. Engineered to protect rooftop and through-the-roof cooler installations from the elements.

seoContent.intro: Down-draft covers protect rooftop coolers that discharge air downward through the building. These installs face full sun, driving rain, and uplift wind — covers need a reinforced top, drainage, and secure tie-down.
highlights: UV-stabilized top panel with optional heat-reflective coating
Drainage grommets to prevent standing water on flat tops
Corner webbing for bungee or ratchet strap attachment
Sized for standard curb-mounted and pad-frame footprints

faqs.q: Do down-draft covers work on all rooftop brands?
faqs.a: Yes, when sized to outside cabinet dimensions. Send model name and photos if the unit has an unusual curb or hood shape.

faqs.q: How do I tie down a rooftop cover?
faqs.a: Route straps through corner webbing to structural anchors — not loose conduit. Re-tighten after 48 hours as fabric seats.

faqs.q: Is a down-draft cover the same as a rooftop cover?
faqs.a: Most down-draft units are rooftop-mounted; our rooftop category adds specs for the harshest exposure class. Either line can be configured to your site.

faqs.q: Should the cover enclose the curb?
faqs.a: Specify curb height on your order. Skirt length can extend below the cabinet to shield the curb from debris.

title: Dust Protection Cooler Covers
features: Ideal for desert and construction-adjacent sites
Pairs with mesh for in-season debris duty
description: Dustproof cooler covers that seal intake panels and keep seasonal debris out of pads, louvers, and water pans during off-season storage and shoulder-season idle periods.

seoContent.intro: Dust protection covers block seasonal dust, pollen, and construction debris from entering pad frames and louvers while the cooler is offline — critical in desert Southwest and agricultural edge communities.
highlights: Tight-weave 600D dust barrier
Optional sealed hem for fine silt
Pairs with winter shutdown workflow
Custom openings without compromising seal zones

faqs.q: Will a dust cover help during fire season?
faqs.a: It reduces ash load on exterior louvers during idle periods. Remove ash before spring startup and inspect pads.

faqs.q: Is mesh enough for dust?
faqs.a: Mesh blocks large debris but not fine dust. Solid or lined covers are better for off-season sealing.

faqs.q: Do I still need to clean the cooler in spring?
faqs.a: Yes. Covers reduce load but inspect and service pads and pans at commissioning.

faqs.q: Can dust covers be breathable?
faqs.a: Select vented hem or hybrid panels if condensation is a concern in humid climates.

title: Evaporative Cooler Covers

internalLinks.label: What Is an Evaporative Cooler Cover?

description: Premium custom-fit covers designed specifically for evaporative coolers. Our covers protect your unit from dust, debris, UV damage, and harsh weather conditions year-round. Available in multiple materials, sizes, and configurations to match any cooler type.

seoContent.intro: Evaporative cooler covers shield your unit during the off-season and between cooling cycles, when accumulated dust, falling debris, and prolonged UV exposure cause most premature wear. A properly fitted cover keeps pads, motor, and louvers protected so the unit starts cleanly next season.
highlights: Made-to-measure for down-draft, side-draft, and window units
Heavier 600D fabric option for high-wind regions
Drawstring or elastic hem to prevent wind lift
Optional bottom drainage to avoid trapped moisture

faqs.q: Should I cover my evaporative cooler in winter?
faqs.a: Yes. Off-season covering keeps freezing water out of pads and panels, prevents debris from clogging the float valve, and protects the motor housing from corrosion.

faqs.q: Do I need to drain the cooler before installing a cover?
faqs.a: Always drain the reservoir and let internal components dry for 24 hours before covering. Trapping moisture under a cover encourages rust and mildew.

faqs.q: How do I measure for a custom cover?
faqs.a: Measure width, depth, and height of the cabinet at the widest points, and note the position of any side ducts or top vents so the cover can be cut to clear them.

faqs.q: What fabric weight should I choose?
faqs.a: 300D polyester suits mild climates; 600D or PVC-laminated fabric is recommended for desert sun, coastal salt air, or rooftop installations exposed to constant wind.

seoContent.intro: Extra-large cooler covers serve commercial evaporative systems with cabinet footprints above typical residential charts — hotels, warehouses, and process cooling plants where a single panel can exceed 50 in. per side.
highlights: Industrial 900D canvas or TPU-laminated options

Engineering review on non-rectangular cabinets

faqs.a: We regularly produce covers above 60 in. per side. Send dimensions for engineering confirmation on span reinforcement.

faqs.q: Are extra-large covers one piece?
faqs.a: Most are single-piece unless access or shipping limits require a two-panel zip join — noted on the quote.

faqs.q: How long is lead time?
faqs.a: Standard extra-large custom orders are 2–3 weeks. Fleet batches may extend to 4 weeks depending on fabric stock.

faqs.q: Do you install on site?
faqs.a: We manufacture and ship. Your HVAC contractor or facilities team installs using our installation guide.

title: Cooler Covers for Extreme Weather
features: Spec review for your climate class
description: Covers engineered for harsh climates — heavy rain, snow load, desert UV, and high wind — using waterproof laminates, insulation, and reinforced hardware.

seoContent.intro: Extreme weather cooler covers combine waterproof shells, insulation, wind anchoring, and UV stabilization for sites with hard winters, monsoon rain, desert sun, or sustained high wind on the roof.
highlights: Climate-class spec on the quote form
Insulated winter and vinyl rain packages
Windproof hardware on exposed installs
Single PO for mixed site conditions

faqs.q: What counts as extreme weather?
faqs.a: Sustained freeze, heavy snow or rain, desert UV over 6 hours daily, or rooftop wind above 30 mph regularly.

faqs.q: One cover or seasonal swap?
faqs.a: Some sites use insulated winter plus UV summer covers; others specify one four-season laminate.

faqs.q: Do I still drain the cooler?
faqs.a: Always. Covers protect the exterior; standing water inside still causes rust and mildew.

faqs.q: Can you advise material from my zip code?
faqs.a: Send city, install type, and photos; we recommend fabric class on the quote.

title: Industrial Cooler Covers
description: Heavy-duty covers engineered for industrial evaporative cooling units. Maximum protection for large-scale installations in factories, plants, and industrial facilities.

seoContent.intro: Industrial cooler covers protect high-capacity evaporative units in factories, food processing, and heavy manufacturing where chemical exposure, heat, and 24/7 duty cycles demand heavier fabric and reinforced hardware.
highlights: Chemical-resistant and fire-retardant fabric options on request
Double-stitched load paths at lift points
Custom access panels for frequent service
Batch consistency for plant-wide cooler fleets

faqs.q: What fabrics suit industrial sites?
faqs.a: 900D TPU-laminated polyester or coated canvas for abrasion; specify chemical exposure so we can recommend compatible coatings.

faqs.q: Do you support plant maintenance contracts?
faqs.a: Yes. Store pattern IDs and material codes for scheduled reorders across shutdown seasons.

faqs.q: Are fire-retardant covers available?
faqs.a: FR-treated fabrics are available on request with certification documentation for your safety team.

faqs.q: How do industrial orders ship?
faqs.a: Folded cartons for small lots; palletized freight for large fleet drops. Export packing available.

title: Insulated Cooler Covers
description: Thermally insulated covers that provide an extra layer of temperature protection. Ideal for extreme climates where heat retention or cold protection is needed.

seoContent.intro: Insulated cooler covers combine a thermal lining with weather-resistant outer fabric to slow temperature swing inside the cabinet. They are used for winter storage, high-altitude sites, and any install where condensation under a single-layer cover is a recurring problem.
highlights: Foam or quilted core bonded to 600D shell
Reduces condensation versus uninsulated solid covers
Available on side-draft and rooftop patterns
Custom thickness for extreme cold zones

faqs.q: How much warmer does insulation keep the cabinet?
faqs.a: Insulation moderates swing rather than heating the unit. It blocks wind chill and reduces frost formation on internal surfaces when the unit is dry and off.

faqs.q: Is insulated the same as winter covers?
faqs.a: Winter covers emphasize freeze and snow protection; insulated covers focus on thermal mass. Many winter SKUs include both features.

faqs.q: Do insulated covers cost more?
faqs.a: Yes — additional material and lamination steps add cost. Volume pricing applies on multi-unit orders.

faqs.q: Can insulation compress in storage?
faqs.a: Store folded loosely; do not stack heavy items on insulated covers long term to preserve loft.

title: Large Cooler Covers
description: Oversized covers for large residential and light commercial evaporative coolers. Reinforced construction to handle the extra material span.

seoContent.intro: Large cooler covers span oversized residential and light-commercial cabinets where standard retail sizes end. Extra fabric width needs reinforced stress points at corners and mid-span to prevent seam failure in wind.
highlights: Reinforced corner and mid-panel stitching
Heavy-duty buckle or ratchet strap options
900D fabric available for spans above 42 in.
Custom measurement for pad-frame overhangs

faqs.q: What counts as a large cooler?
faqs.a: Generally cabinets with any exterior dimension above 40 in. or commercial pad frames that exceed residential charts. Measure outside dimensions to confirm.

faqs.q: Do large covers need more tie-downs?
faqs.a: Yes. Use all provided anchor points; rooftop large spans often need four-corner ratchet straps.

faqs.q: Is there a weight limit for shipping?
faqs.a: Very large covers fold for UPS ground. Multi-cover freight orders ship on pallets — quoted at checkout for bulk.

faqs.q: Can one cover fit multiple brands?
faqs.a: Only if cabinet dimensions match. Size to measurement, not model name alone.

title: Mesh Cooler Covers
description: Breathable mesh covers that protect against debris and pests while allowing airflow. Perfect for in-season use or mild climates.

seoContent.intro: Mesh cooler covers filter leaves, pollen, and pests while allowing airflow through the cabinet. They suit in-season protection in mild climates or as a breathable layer when a solid cover would trap condensation.
highlights: High-density polyester mesh (~1 mm aperture)
Ultra-light for frequent removal during operating season
Elastic hem for tool-free install
Pairs with solid winter covers for year-round strategy

faqs.q: Will mesh stop fine dust?
faqs.a: Mesh blocks larger debris and pests. Fine desert dust may pass — use a solid 600D cover for off-season sealing.

faqs.q: Can I run the cooler with a mesh cover on?
faqs.a: Only if the cover is designed for operating clearance and does not restrict intake paths. Most mesh covers are for idle units with airflow needs.

faqs.q: How do I clean a mesh cover?
faqs.a: Hose down with cool water and mild soap; air-dry fully before storage. Avoid machine agitation that can snag the mesh.

faqs.q: Mesh vs vented solid cover?
faqs.a: Mesh is fully breathable. Vented solid covers combine fabric panels with screened ports — better rain resistance with some airflow.

title: Outdoor Cooler Covers
description: All-weather outdoor cooler covers for units exposed to sun, rain, wind, and debris year-round — heavier fabrics, UV packages, and secure tie-down for exterior installs.

seoContent.intro: Outdoor cooler covers are specified for units that live outside full time — sun, rain, wind, and debris between seasons. Material choice matters more than on sheltered wall mounts.
highlights: UV and waterproof packages for exposure class
Wind tie-down on open yards and roofs
Drainage grommets on horizontal tops
Vented options for humid shoulder seasons

faqs.q: Is outdoor the same as rooftop?
faqs.a: Rooftop is a subset of outdoor with higher wind and UV load. Rooftop SKUs add corner webbing and reflective tops.

faqs.q: Can I use mesh outdoors year-round?
faqs.a: Mesh is for debris and airflow in mild idle periods, not full winter sealing in wet climates.

faqs.q: What fabric for coastal outdoor?
faqs.a: Waterproof or vinyl-backed lines resist salt spray; rinse covers periodically to reduce salt buildup.

faqs.q: How long can an outdoor cover stay on?
faqs.a: Entire off-season is normal. Remove at spring commissioning, dry, and store loosely folded.

faqs.q: Do oversized covers cost more to ship?

faqs.q: Can oversized covers include logos?

seoContent.intro: Residential cooler covers protect home evaporative units during off-season shutdown — blocking duct drafts, dust, and pests with lightweight fabrics that one person can install on a ladder or at ground level.
highlights: Side-draft, window, and compact rooftop homes
Winter draft sealing for connected ductwork
Affordable 600D standard line
Custom size when the home unit is non-chart

faqs.q: Do I need a different cover for winter?
faqs.a: Many homeowners use one quality 600D cover year-round for shutdown; cold climates may add insulated winter SKUs.

faqs.q: Will covering stop cold air from my ducts?
faqs.a: Yes, when the cover seals intake panels and you block the interior duct opening per our winterizing guide.

faqs.q: Can I buy just one cover?
faqs.a: Yes. Small-batch custom sizing accepts single residential orders.

faqs.q: How do I pick the right type?
faqs.a: Start with configuration — side draft, down draft, or window — then measure outside dimensions.

title: Rooftop Cooler Covers
description: Heavy-duty covers designed for rooftop-mounted evaporative coolers. Built to withstand direct sun exposure, high winds, and precipitation at elevated installations.

seoContent.intro: Rooftop-mounted coolers take more punishment than any other installation: unfiltered sun, gusting wind, and pooling rain all hit the unit at once. A rooftop-grade cover uses heavier fabric, reinforced corners, and a tie-down system designed to hold under sustained wind loads.
highlights: Heat-reflective top panel to reduce cabinet temperature
Reinforced webbing at all four corners for tie-down points
Drainage grommets to prevent water pooling
UV-stabilized fabric rated for direct rooftop exposure

faqs.q: Can a rooftop cover handle high winds?
faqs.a: Rooftop covers ship with reinforced corner webbing and either bungee cords or ratchet straps. For sustained winds above 40 mph we recommend the 600D fabric option with all four tie-downs anchored.

faqs.q: Will the cover trap heat and damage the unit?
faqs.a: No. A correctly sized cover is breathable along the hem and the unit is off when covered. The reflective top panel actually lowers cabinet temperature compared with leaving the unit exposed.

faqs.q: How long does a rooftop cover last?
faqs.a: With UV-stabilized 600D fabric and proper tie-down, expect 4 to 6 seasons of full rooftop exposure before the topcoat degrades. Sheltered installations last considerably longer.

faqs.q: Do you make covers for non-standard rooftop units?
faqs.a: Yes. Send dimensions and a photo of the unit, and we can quote a custom-cut cover with openings positioned for any side ducts or service panels.

title: Rooftop HVAC Cooler Covers
description: Protective covers for rooftop-mounted evaporative coolers and packaged HVAC cabinets — curb-height sizing, flange-friendly hems, and roof-safe water shedding.

seoContent.intro: Rooftop HVAC cooler covers fit packaged evaporative and hybrid rooftop cabinets — sized to curb height or cabinet base, with hems that shed water away from the roof flange.
highlights: Curb-inclusive or cabinet-only height
Flange-friendly hem geometry
Pairs with down-draft and rooftop cooler lines
Commercial facility fleet specs

faqs.q: Is this different from rooftop cooler covers?
faqs.a: This category emphasizes HVAC rooftop application and curb sizing. Product construction overlaps our rooftop cooler cover line.

faqs.q: Should the cover include the curb?
faqs.a: Specify on order. Include curb height if the hem must seat below the curb top; otherwise measure cabinet only.

faqs.q: Will the cover damage my roof?
faqs.a: A fitted cover that sheds water outward reduces pooling on the cabinet top; it does not replace proper flashing maintenance.

faqs.q: Do facility managers get volume pricing?
faqs.a: Yes. Multi-building portfolios often standardize one fabric code across curb heights.

title: Round Cooler Covers
description: Custom-shaped covers for round and cylindrical evaporative coolers. Precision-cut for a snug fit around circular cooler units.

seoContent.intro: Round cooler covers fit cylindrical and barrel-style evaporative cabinets that rectangular universal covers cannot seal. Patterns use a circular top, side panel, and elastic or drawcord hem sized to your diameter and height.
highlights: Standard diameters from 60 cm to 100 cm plus custom
Top drainage eyelet on horizontal round tops
Elastic hem option for tapered cylinders
Same material range as rectangular custom line

faqs.q: How do I measure a round cooler?
faqs.a: Measure outside diameter at the widest point and straight-side height from base to top of cabinet, excluding unrelated roof flashing.

faqs.q: What if my unit tapers?
faqs.a: Note top and bottom diameter on the order form. We pattern with darts or a tapered panel so the hem sits flat.

faqs.q: Are round covers only for industrial units?
faqs.a: No. Residential barrel-style coolers and older OEM round cabinets use the same sizing method.

faqs.q: Can round covers have side openings?
faqs.a: Yes. Mark duct or service panel locations on your photo sheet for reinforced cutouts.

title: Side Draft Cooler Covers
description: Purpose-built covers for side-draft evaporative coolers. Designed with proper ventilation openings and secure fit for wall-mounted and ground-level side-draft units.

seoContent.intro: Side-draft cooler covers fit wall-mounted and ground-level units where air enters from the side. Covers must clear water lines, electrical boxes, and pad frames without stretching fabric over sharp cabinet edges.
highlights: Patterns cut for exterior disconnect boxes and side ducts
Reinforced hems along the wall-mount edge
Water-resistant PU coating standard on 600D fabric
Optional split-corner for junction box clearance

faqs.q: How is side-draft different from down-draft?
faqs.a: Side-draft units pull air through a wall face; down-draft units discharge downward from the roof. Cover shape and opening placement differ — specify your draft type when ordering.

faqs.q: Should side vents be covered or screened?
faqs.a: Off-season solid covers are typical. Screened vents are available if you need airflow while keeping debris out.

faqs.q: What if my water line exits the side?
faqs.a: Mark the pipe location on your dimension sheet. We position a reinforced opening or notch so the cover does not kink the line.

faqs.q: Can I use a universal cover on a side-draft unit?
faqs.a: Universal covers often gap at the wall line. A measured custom cover prevents wind flap and water intrusion at the hem.

title: Small Batch Cooler Covers

seoContent.intro: Small-batch cooler covers let you order one unit or a short run without meeting bulk minimums. Ideal for prototypes, historic buildings with odd cabinets, or contractors testing a fabric before a fleet rollout.
highlights: No minimum quantity on the small-batch line
Full custom dimensions and openings

faqs.q: Is there a price penalty for one cover?
faqs.a: Single-unit pricing reflects setup and cutting time. Per-unit cost drops quickly as quantity increases.

faqs.q: Can I order a sample before bulk?
faqs.a: Yes. Order one cover in production fabric or request a material swatch with your quote.

faqs.q: What is the fastest turnaround?
faqs.a: Simple rectangular covers in stock fabric often ship within 5–7 business days after proof approval.

faqs.q: When should I switch to bulk ordering?
faqs.a: When you need 25+ units or repeat seasonal buys — bulk tiers and stored patterns reduce cost and lead time.

title: Square & Rectangular Cooler Covers

description: Covers for standard box-profile evaporative coolers — the most common cabinet shape for side-draft and down-draft residential and commercial units.

seoContent.intro: Square and rectangular cooler covers fit the box-profile cabinets used on most side-draft and down-draft units. Sizing follows outside width × depth × height with standard charts or full custom cutting.
highlights: Matches dominant residential and light-commercial shapes
Corner gussets on spans above 40 in.
Duct and electrical cutouts positioned from photos
Stock gray, beige, and charcoal; custom colors on volume

faqs.q: How is this different from round covers?
faqs.a: Rectangular patterns follow flat panel cabinets. Round covers use diameter × height for cylindrical units.

faqs.q: What if my cooler is almost square but not quite?
faqs.a: Measure each face; we cut to the true outline rather than forcing a square chart size.

faqs.q: Do you support side-draft only?
faqs.a: No. Rectangular patterns also fit down-draft and many rooftop box cabinets.

faqs.q: When should I go custom size?
faqs.a: When any exterior dimension falls between chart sizes or hardware conflicts with a stock pattern.

title: Swamp Cooler Covers
description: High-quality covers for swamp coolers (evaporative coolers) in all sizes and configurations. Protect your swamp cooler from off-season damage with our durable, weather-resistant covers.

seoContent.intro: Swamp cooler covers protect evaporative coolers during the off-season and between cooling cycles. Whether your unit is wall-mounted or on the roof, a fitted cover blocks dust, wind-driven rain, and UV damage that shortens pad and cabinet life.
highlights: Fits side-draft, down-draft, and window swamp coolers
Water-resistant 600D polyester standard; waterproof upgrade available
Elastic hem, drawcord, or strap tie-down options
Custom sizes when your model is not on a standard chart

faqs.q: Is a swamp cooler cover the same as an evaporative cooler cover?
faqs.a: Yes. Swamp cooler and evaporative cooler refer to the same equipment type. Covers are sized to the outside cabinet dimensions.

faqs.q: When should I put the cover on?
faqs.a: After shutdown, drain the reservoir, dry internal components for 24 hours, then install the cover for off-season or extended idle periods.

faqs.q: Do I need a different cover for rooftop units?
faqs.a: Rooftop swamp coolers benefit from heavier fabric, corner tie-downs, and a reflective top panel. See our rooftop and down-draft categories for those specs.

faqs.q: Can I leave the cover on in summer?
faqs.a: Off-season and storage use is recommended. If you need in-season debris protection, consider a breathable mesh cover instead of a solid winter-weight cover.

title: UV-Resistant Cooler Covers
description: Covers with advanced UV-blocking technology to prevent sun damage, fading, and material degradation. Essential for coolers in direct sunlight.

seoContent.intro: UV-resistant cooler covers use stabilizers and reflective coatings to slow fabric breakdown and color fade under direct sun. They are essential for rooftop units and southwest exposures where untreated polyester fails in two seasons or less.
highlights: UPF 50+ rated fabric options on select SKUs
Silver or white reflective tops to reduce heat load
Fade-resistant dyes on charcoal and navy stocks
Compatible with 600D and 900D base fabrics

faqs.q: How long will a UV cover last in full sun?
faqs.a: With 600D UV-stabilized fabric and proper tie-down, expect 4–6 seasons on rooftop exposure. Sheltered wall units last longer.

faqs.q: Is reflective color required?
faqs.a: Not required but recommended for horizontal top panels. Side faces can use standard gray or beige with UV stabilizer in the coating.

faqs.q: Does UV protection help the cooler inside?
faqs.a: A reflective top lowers cabinet surface temperature versus bare metal or dark fabric, reducing heat soak between cycles.

faqs.q: Can I add UV coating to any cover?
faqs.a: UV stabilizer is specified at order time for compatible fabrics. It is standard on our UV-shield product line.

title: Waterproof Cooler Covers
description: Fully waterproof cooler covers with sealed seams and water-repellent coatings. Ideal for regions with heavy rainfall or humid climates.

seoContent.intro: Waterproof cooler covers use laminated fabric and sealed seams to keep rain out of pads, motors, and float assemblies. They suit regions with sustained wet seasons or units stored outdoors without a roof overhang.
highlights: PVC-backed or TPU-laminated fabric options
Sealed seam construction on premium lines
Anti-mildew treatment on interior face
Drainage grommets at low points on large tops

faqs.q: What is the difference between waterproof and water-resistant?
faqs.a: Water-resistant fabric sheds light rain; waterproof covers with sealed seams handle standing water and driving rain. See our rain-proof feature page for construction detail.

faqs.q: Do waterproof covers trap moisture inside?
faqs.a: Only if the unit is covered while wet inside. Drain and dry the cooler first; vented hems allow slow breathability on most models.

faqs.q: What waterproof rating should I look for?
faqs.a: Our premium line targets 5000 mm hydrostatic head on PVC-backed polyester. Specify exposure class if the unit is in direct monsoon or coastal spray.

faqs.q: Are waterproof covers heavier?
faqs.a: Yes. PVC-backed covers are stiffer than 600D oxford. Plan for stronger tie-downs on rooftop spans.

title: Window Cooler Covers
description: Custom-fit covers for window-mounted evaporative coolers. Protect your window unit from dust and weather damage during the off-season without removing it.

seoContent.intro: Window cooler covers fit units mounted in or against a window frame without removing the cooler for off-season storage. Low-profile hems and insulating liners reduce drafts and dust infiltration through the seasonal gap.
highlights: Frame-friendly hem that does not scar siding or trim
Compact fold for off-season closet storage
Lightweight 420D–600D fabric for one-person install
Custom cut for non-standard window openings

faqs.q: Can I install the cover from inside?
faqs.a: Most window units are covered from outside for a weather-tight seal. Indoor slip covers are available for climate-controlled storage rooms.

faqs.q: Will the cover block my window?
faqs.a: The cover fits over the cooler cabinet only. It does not replace interior window insulation unless you specify a full-frame panel.

faqs.q: How do I measure a window cooler?
faqs.a: Measure the exterior cabinet width, depth from wall to outermost point, and total height including any lift lid.

faqs.q: Are window covers insulated?
faqs.a: Standard line is water-resistant polyester. Insulated laminate is available for cold-climate off-season storage.

title: Windproof Cooler Covers
features: Corner webbing and ratchet strap points
Compatible with down-draft and rooftop units
description: Wind-rated cooler covers with reinforced tie-down points, corner webbing, and secure hem systems for rooftop and exposed installations where gusts lift standard covers.

seoContent.intro: Windproof cooler covers use reinforced corner webbing, grommets, and ratchet or bungee tie-down points so covers stay seated on rooftop and exposed installs when gusts exceed 30 mph.
highlights: Four-corner anchor points on rooftop SKUs
900D option for sustained wind exposure
Hem drawcord plus strap redundancy
Engineering review on wide horizontal tops

faqs.q: How many tie-downs do I need?
faqs.a: Minimum two for sheltered ground units; four corners recommended for rooftop and open desert sites.

faqs.q: Is windproof the same as waterproof?
faqs.a: No. Windproof addresses lift and tear; waterproof addresses rain penetration. Many harsh-climate specs combine both.

faqs.q: Can I add straps to an existing cover?
faqs.a: We manufacture with hardware at order time. Field-added grommets can weaken sealed zones on waterproof lines.

faqs.q: What wind speed are covers rated for?
faqs.a: Properly tied 600D covers are field-rated to ~40 mph; 900D with four ratchets handle higher sustained loads.

title: Winter Cooler Covers
description: Insulated winter covers to protect your evaporative cooler during cold months. Prevent freezing, ice damage, and debris accumulation throughout winter.

seoContent.intro: Winter cooler covers add insulation and a tight perimeter seal to protect evaporative coolers from freeze damage, ice buildup, and wind-blown snow during months when the unit is offline.
highlights: Foam-core or quilted lining options for thermal barrier
Snow-shedding top shape to reduce accumulation load
Tight drawcord or zipper closure at the hem
Pair with full drain-down before install

faqs.q: Will an insulated cover prevent pipe freeze?
faqs.a: It reduces heat loss and blocks wind chill on the cabinet. Always drain water lines per your winterization checklist — the cover is one layer of protection.

faqs.q: Can I use a winter cover in summer?
faqs.a: Solid insulated covers are for off-season use. For summer debris protection, use mesh or vented covers instead.

faqs.q: How thick is the insulation?
faqs.a: Typical foam cores range 3–5 mm depending on fabric package. Specify your climate zone for a material recommendation.

faqs.q: When should I remove the winter cover?
faqs.a: Remove before startup in spring, inspect pads and pan, then run the unit before the cooling season peak.
